status: Generic starter vocabulary for zero-shot tool/part detection (YOLO-World). No fine-tuning or per-station labeled data required -- this is a versioned, editable text query list, not a trained model. Extend per station as needed without touching code.

changelog.note: Initial abstract/compound phrases (e.g. 'housing part', 'small mechanical part'). Benchmarked against the real video at conf>=0.01: zero detections above threshold for every query.

Replaced with simple, concrete single/two-word nouns after confirming YOLO-World matches these far better than compound factory-jargon phrases (e.g. 'glove' scored 0.47, 'box' 0.40, 'person' 0.93 on the same frame that scored 0 on every v0.1.0 query). Vocabulary describes what things LOOK like generically (glove, box, bottle-shaped tool) rather than what they're called in this specific factory (housing part, bush) -- station-specific meaning is applied later by the VLM/human, not by this detector.
